# fledgling

> young and inexperienced; describing any new participant in some activity Murray has years of experience in family practice, but he is just a fledgling in surgery.

> A young bird that has just recently gotten its feathers, an inexperienced person (noun); new or inexperienced (adj)

> untried or inexperienced; emergent or rising
